label: ETV6::JAK2

sections.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain.
JAK2 encodes a nonreceptor tyrosine kinase that transduces cytokine-receptor signals.
The fusion retains the JAK2 tyrosine-kinase region and removes normal amino-terminal control, producing constitutive JAK-STAT signaling. ETV6::JAK2 is associated with myeloid/lymphoid neoplasia.
